BRANCH CHIEF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY SPECIALIST
Profile:
Motivated Communication Technology and Cyber security professional with outstanding managerial and customer service skills, excellent written and verbal communication skills, seeks challenging position with an organization where I can make a big impact with my multifaceted experience, training and education. Excellent record of problem solving and achieving results in high-operations-tempo environments. Successful team leader and highly-motivated mentor with proven dedication to learn and elaborate improvement. “Superior knowledge of INFORSEC/NETOPS techniques to determine requirements for information technology equipment and systems. Excellent knowledge and ability to negotiate in financial matters, budget and security management. Working knowledge of budget and cost analysis processes. “Thorough knowledge of Office of Management and Budget (OMB), Department of Defense (DOD) and U.S. Air Force regulations, principles and practices pertaining to logistics, supply, systems, installations, and mission support functions. Exceptional ability to recognize and analyze complex research. INFORSEC/NETOPS, installations, and recommendations. Recognized expert DoD planning, programming, budgeting and execution (PB&E) process. “Expert in capability planning in IT environment, enterprise technical Certification and Accreditation standards, and CORI process. Procedures, security practices, and IA vulnerability tools. ACAS. “Ability to apply knowledge of current security tools, and techniques to execute Authority to Connect and Authority to Operate (ATO) processes. Thorough knowledge of SCADA systems operations, security, safeguards and protection (“SECURITY CLEARANCE: TOP SECRET [SCI]”) CV Photograph
Professional Experience
07/2014 to Current
Branch Chief Information Technology Specialist Company Name V.C. City
- Effectively oversee, manage, and evaluate multiple enterprise level IT programs, serve as senior technical advisor and evaluator for programs cutting edge technology for the Headquarters Air Force (AF) command, control, communications, computer, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (C4ISR).
- Establishes, develops, and maintains effective working relationships with top functional managers, program managers, commanders, contractors, vendors, DoD and other non-DoD agencies, and communications and information personnel in the National Capital Region.
- Researches and recommends innovative approaches to resolve major IT problems.
- Performs complex analysis of project management, system integration, and oversight responsibilities such as feasibility studies, systems analysis, systems development, implementation, engineers, and problem resolution.
08/2010 to 07/2014
Information Technology Specialist (INFORSEC) NETOPS Company Name V.C. City
- Developed, operated plans plus cell formations and support for the state of the strategic, operational, and tactical levels of cyber warfare.
- Cyber tactical solutions plus cell formations operations supporting the state of the strategic, operational, and tactical levels of cyber warfare.
- Enabled cross-functional collaboration between the U.S. Army, U.S. Air Force, and U.S. Navy.
- Provided technical support and guidance to a diverse team of IT professionals.
